headline: Team India Guaranty Limited announces the outcome of its board meeting
hook: Routine board meeting update from Team India Guaranty
summary: Team India Guaranty Limited has formally submitted the outcome of its board meeting held on November 26, 2026, to the exchange. Such procedural filings are routine corporate governance updates required for listed entities. This disclosure does not contain details of major financial performance or strategic shifts. Retail investors should note this is a standard compliance filing with limited direct impact on stock valuation.
